sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders suffered their most recent loss but remain in strong form overall with seven wins from their last six games. Alsager arrive winless in their last five matches and struggling near the bottom of the division, making this a fixture Sandbach will be favoured to control.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back after their own recent loss and maintain pressure on the leaders. AFC Bridgnorth (3rd) host Eccleshall (5th) in a match between two of the division's stronger performers, while Wolverhampton Casuals (4th) entertain Wednesfield Community (9th) in what should favour the visitors given their superior league position. Bilston Town (6th), in excellent recent form with four wins in five, host struggling Foley Meir (13th) at home. Barnton (7th) visit Shawbury United (15th), who are in dire straits with five consecutive defeats. Market Drayton Town (10th) face New Mills (8th) in a mid-table encounter. Brereton Social (14th) host Widnes Town (20th) in a clash between two of the division's poorest performers, with Widnes in freefall. Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th) travel to Crewe (16th), another low-table battle. Finally, Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October at 19:45 in a midweek fixture between struggling sides.
